label: infra-frac-probe
_why: §10.60 FRACTIONAL-INFRASTRUCTURE VERIFICATION: the factored port tiers emit state_infrastructure_add = 0.3/0.4/1.2 - fractional values with NO vanilla precedent for this modifier (grep: none). Cross-check: testbed/saves_debut vanilla melts of the same states. Tonight's century n=2 rides on the answer.
